tools.name: check_recall_causes
tools.description: Top hazards, China-origin alert counts and share of published alerts by matching product category in UK OPSS and EU Safety Gate data windows, with supplier due-diligence questions and dated sources. Published alerts are not a product failure rate.

tools.name: screen_supplier_name
tools.description: Possible English or Chinese name matches against UK Sanctions List entities, CN/HK US Consolidated Screening List entities and UFLPA entities, with match type and dated sources. Automated name check, not legal advice; a match needs manual review; no match is not clearance.

tools.name: check_export_rebate_change
tools.description: Changes in tracked Chinese export rebate announcements covering an HS code prefix, with announcement number, effective date and previous and new percentages. This historical announcement lookup is not the current rate.

tools.name: find_duty_rate
tools.description: Use when the user asks what duty rate or commodity code applies to a product imported from China to the UK: finds the UK commodity code and import duty rate from a product description (English or Chinese) or a commodity code. tools.name: estimate_landed_cost

tools.name: estimate_container_space
tools.description: Use when the user asks for the CBM of a shipment or how many containers a carton line needs: estimates CBM, shipment weight and volume-only 20ft/40ft/high-cube container counts from one carton line. Useful for full-container RFQ planning; not a loading simulation or a freight quote.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: screen_supplier_name, search_guides, get_company_facts, get_verification_standard, submit_enquiry · Private data: find_uk_compliance, submit_enquiry · Public sink: check_recall_causes, submit_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: screen_supplier_name, search_guides, get_company_facts, get_verification_standard, submit_enquiry · Private data: find_uk_compliance, submit_enquiry · Public sink: check_recall_causes, submit_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
